An '''energy envelope projector''' was a specialized energy [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that was installed on [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. The projectors encased the projectiles in an energy shroud during flight.

==Description==
Projectiles such as the [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]] [[MG7-A proton torpedo/Legends|MG7-A proton torpedo]] and the [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[ST2 concussion missile/Legends|ST2 concussion missile]] had multiple energy envelope projectors. When launched, the projectiles were sheathed in a protective energy shroud by the projectors. This weak energy shield protected the projectile from being prematurely detonated by collisions with space debris or near misses from [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The energy shroud, combined with the speed of the projectile, made missiles appear much more like blasts from a laser cannon.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
